title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment — II (SAFFIRE-II)
scientific_focus: Spacecraft fire safety; material flammability limits
objectives: Test the low-gravity flammability behavior of different spacecraft-relevant materials and determine how oxygen and material type affect ignition and flame spread.
approach: Conduct remotely initiated burning tests of several smaller material samples in a Cygnus vehicle after separation from the ISS; measure flame development and environmental conditions with onboard sensors.
